haikus.haiku:
Steam curls, silver bowl
Spoons twirl, broth sings clear and steam
Noodles dance, joy flows
Happy #NationalNoodleDay

Tea steam curls bright soft
Cups clink, hats twirl, laughter rings
Whisked sugar clouds rise
Happy #MadHatterDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Steam whistles rise high
Gears turn in bright joy today
Candles glow like sparks
#HappyBirthdayGeorgeWestinghouse from @ClamBakeSanta
